scoring.selector: m2b_score.select: the delivered final answer less the host's search-limit notice (optimus.agent.index_turn.LIMIT_NOTICE); its digest is the script's
scoring.hardening: Fable CP1 finding 2: ordinary-word symbol names count only as code (backticks, a call) or by qualified name; numbers match whole; fences cut at the cap count; QO4's unfenced code-like lines must be the file's own; QB1 F2 drops hedge phrases; a path echo plus a hedge fails every case but QO4 (tested)
scoring.v3: Codex finding 5: claim-bound citations (path and code-form symbol in one clause, or a range of at most 40 lines overlapping the symbol); loci; fact groups; runner status first (stop reason or output at the cap: INCOMPLETE); boundary rows; the QO4 quote control needs the exact contiguous block
scoring.v4: Codex attempt 2 finding 5: a fact is a relationship, every group and its supporting locus in one paragraph, no carrying sentence negated unless the fact is a negation, forbidden extras absent; loci name code or a forward narrow range; reversed ranges fail; an answer is scored only on a settled row; a boundary needs the declared stop, zero requests and no emitted answer; the QO4 control needs exactly one exact fenced block and no other code, or a sentence naming the requested lines or source as unavailable with no code. Tested with independently written answers and contradictions, including Codex's QB2 example

runner.guard: Codex findings 3 (round 122, attempt 2): the Guard refuses before forwarding unless the row's allowance, the released model (Approved.model_id; the approved hash fixes its route), the approved hash and output cap, the input cap (the route's estimator), every earlier send reconciled with its host receipts, and the ceiling's reservation all hold; each refusal, the reservation's included, is recorded on the row
runner.accounting: physical attempts from the Gateway's route attempts (completed, uncertain, rejected; not_sent excluded); each Gateway attempt matched to exactly one host receipt by Gateway request id, attempt ordinal and disposition; duplicate, unmatched and unclaimed records kept, each a reconciliation problem that makes the row incomplete and stops the run; a send with no Gateway attempt counts MAX_ROUTE_ATTEMPTS unknown attempts; unclaimed physical receipts are still settled against the ceiling
